```{r, fig.width=4, fig.height=5}
# Define pathogenic classes
pathogenic_classes <- c("pathogenic", "likely_pathogenic")

# Add shape column
brca1_df2 <- brca1_df %>%
  mutate(
    clinvar_group = case_when(
      clinvar_clinical_significance %in% c("pathogenic", "likely_pathogenic") ~
        "Pathogenic",
      clinvar_clinical_significance %in% c("benign", "likely_benign") ~
        "Benign",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    clinvar_group = factor(
      clinvar_group,
      levels = c(
        "Pathogenic",
        "Benign",
        "Other"
      )
    )
  )

# Compute Spearman correlation
spearman_r <- cor(brca1_df2$ESM.1v, brca1_df2$DMS_score, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")
subtitle_text <- sprintf("Spearman correlation: %.3f", spearman_r)

# Plot
ggplot(brca1_df2, aes(x = ESM.1v, y = DMS_score)) +
  geom_point(
    aes(
      shape = clinvar_group,
      color = clinvar_group,
      alpha = clinvar_group        # <-- map alpha to group
    ),
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(
    "Pathogenic" = 17,
    "Benign" = 16,
    "Other" = 16
  )) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Other" = "grey",
    "Benign" = "#1B9E77",
    "Pathogenic" = "#D95F02"
  )) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c(
    "Other" = 0.7,      # transparent grey
    "Benign" = 1,       # solid
    "Pathogenic" = 1    # solid
  ), guide = "none") +  # hide alpha legend
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", size = 1) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  labs(
    title = "BRCA1 (Findlay et al., 2018)",
    subtitle = subtitle_text,
    x = "ESM1v score",
    y = "DMS score (ProteinGym normalized)",
    shape = "",
    color = ""
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r}
transform_score <- function(x, invert_scale = FALSE) {
  ranks <- rank(x, ties.method = "average")
  min_r <- min(ranks, na.rm = TRUE); max_r <- max(ranks, na.rm = TRUE)
  norm <- if(max_r == min_r) rep(0, length(ranks)) else (ranks - min_r) / (max_r - min_r)
  if(invert_scale) return(1 - norm) else return(norm)
}

processed_data <- brca1_df %>%
  drop_na(function_score, ESM.1v) %>%
  mutate(
    # Normalize: 0 = WT, 1 = Pathogenic
    SGE_Pathogenicity = transform_score(function_score, invert_scale = TRUE),
    ESM_Pathogenicity = transform_score(ESM.1v, invert_scale = TRUE),
    # Delta: Positive = SGE is higher (Under-predicted/MAVE-damaging)
    #        Negative = VEP is higher (Over-predicted/VEP-damaging)
    Delta_Pathogenicity = SGE_Pathogenicity - ESM_Pathogenicity
  )

print(processed_data)
summary(processed_data$function_score)
summary(processed_data$ESM.1v)
summary(processed_data$Delta_Pathogenicity)

cutoff_mave_damaging <- quantile(processed_data$Delta_Pathogenicity, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE) # Top 5%
cutoff_vep_damaging  <- quantile(processed_data$Delta_Pathogenicity, 0.05, na.rm = TRUE) # Bottom 5%
cutoff_concordant    <- quantile(abs(processed_data$Delta_Pathogenicity), 0.05, na.rm = TRUE) # Smallest 5% gap

plotting_data <- processed_data %>%
  mutate(
    # 1. Define Discordance Classes using Percentiles
    Discordance_Class = case_when(
      Delta_Pathogenicity >= cutoff_mave_damaging ~ "MAVE-damaging\n(Under-predicted)",
      Delta_Pathogenicity <= cutoff_vep_damaging  ~ "VEP-damaging\n(Over-predicted)",
      abs(Delta_Pathogenicity) <= cutoff_concordant ~ "Strictly Concordant\n(Reference)",
      TRUE ~ "Intermediate" # The remaining 85% of data
    ),
    
    # 2. Define Site Type (Update these IDs for your protein!)
    site_type = ifelse(pos_pdb %in% active_site_residues, "Active Site", "Other")
  )
```

```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height=5}
comparison_data <- plotting_data %>%
```

```{r, fig.width=6, fig.height=5}
library(ggsignif)

# Define the pairwise comparisons you want to test
comparisons_list <- list(
  c("Strictly Concordant\n(Reference)", "VEP-damaging\n(Over-predicted)"),
  c("Strictly Concordant\n(Reference)", "MAVE-damaging\n(Under-predicted)"),
  c("MAVE-damaging\n(Under-predicted)", "VEP-damaging\n(Over-predicted)")
)

# Calculate a nice upper bound for significance bars
y_max <- max(plotting_data$exposure_rasa, na.rm = TRUE)

p3 <- ggplot(plotting_data, aes(x = Discordance_Class, y = exposure_rasa, fill = Discordance_Class)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.5, color = NA) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_signif(
    comparisons = comparisons_list,
    map_signif_level = TRUE,
    step_increase = 0.15,          # Automatically stack significance bars
    y_position = c(y_max*1.05, y_max*1.18, y_max*1.31)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Intermediate" = "grey80",
    "Strictly Concordant\n(Reference)" = "black",
    "MAVE-damaging\n(Under-predicted)" = "#D55E00",
    "VEP-damaging\n(Over-predicted)" = "#0072B2"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "BRCA1 (Findlay et al., 2018)",
    subtitle = "Distribution of RSA | High RSA = Surface",
    y = "Relative Solvent Accessibility (RSA)",
    x = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 15, hjust = 1)
  )
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(cowplot)

# --- 1. Define the Deltas ---
# We need to compare two distinct "gaps":
# Gap 1 (The Signal): How different is ESM1v from Stability? (Your Allosteric Effect)
# Gap 2 (The Noise):  How different is SGE from ESM1v? (The Prediction Error)

# Ensure normalized scores are present (0-1 scale)
processed_data <- processed_data %>%
  mutate(
    # Normalize inputs if not already done
    norm_ESM = transform_score(ESM.1v, invert_scale = TRUE),
    norm_SGE = transform_score(function_score, invert_scale = TRUE),
    norm_Stability = transform_score(ddG_pred, invert_scale = FALSE) # Assuming ddG high = unstable
  )

# Calculate Residuals (The rigorous "Delta")
# 1. The Allosteric Signal: What part of ESM1v is NOT explained by Stability?
model_signal <- loess(norm_ESM ~ norm_Stability, data = processed_data, span = 0.7)
processed_data$Delta_Allostery <- residuals(model_signal)

# 2. The Prediction Error: What part of SGE is NOT predicted by ESM1v?
model_error <- loess(norm_SGE ~ norm_ESM, data = processed_data, span = 0.7)
processed_data$Delta_Error <- residuals(model_error)

# --- 2. Statistical Comparison of Variances ---
var_signal <- var(processed_data$Delta_Allostery, na.rm = TRUE)
var_error  <- var(processed_data$Delta_Error, na.rm = TRUE)
signal_to_noise <- var_signal / var_error

print(paste("Variance of Allosteric Signal:", round(var_signal, 4)))
print(paste("Variance of Prediction Error:", round(var_error, 4)))
print(paste("Signal-to-Noise Ratio:", round(signal_to_noise, 2)))

# --- 3. Visualization: Overlaid Density Plot ---
plot_df <- processed_data %>%
  dplyr::select(mutant, Delta_Allostery, Delta_Error) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("Delta_Allostery", "Delta_Error"), names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value") %>%
  mutate(Metric_Label = case_when(
    Metric == "Delta_Allostery" ~ "Allosteric Signal\n(ESM1v - Stability)",
    Metric == "Delta_Error"     ~ "Prediction Error\n(SGE - ESM1v)"
  ))

p_density <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Value, fill = Metric_Label)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Allosteric Signal\n(ESM1v - Stability)" = "#E69F00", 
                               "Prediction Error\n(SGE - ESM1v)" = "#56B4E9")) +
  labs(title = "Magnitude of Allosteric Signal vs. Prediction Error",
       subtitle = paste0("Signal variance is ", round(signal_to_noise, 1), "x larger than Error variance"),
       x = "Residual Magnitude (Delta)",
       y = "Density",
       fill = "Component") +
```

```{r, fig.width=6, fig.height=5}
library(ggsignif)

# Define the pairwise comparisons you want to test
comparisons_list <- list(
  c("Strictly Concordant\n(Reference)", "VEP-damaging\n(Over-predicted)"),
  c("Strictly Concordant\n(Reference)", "MAVE-damaging\n(Under-predicted)"),
  c("MAVE-damaging\n(Under-predicted)", "VEP-damaging\n(Over-predicted)")
)

# Calculate a nice upper bound for significance bars
y_max <- max(plotting_data$exposure_rasa, na.rm = TRUE)

p3 <- ggplot(plotting_data, aes(x = Discordance_Class, y = exposure_rasa, fill = Discordance_Class)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.5, color = NA) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_signif(
    comparisons = comparisons_list,
    map_signif_level = TRUE,
    step_increase = 0.15,          # Automatically stack significance bars
    y_position = c(y_max*1.05, y_max*1.18, y_max*1.31)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Intermediate" = "grey80",
    "Strictly Concordant\n(Reference)" = "black",
    "MAVE-damaging\n(Under-predicted)" = "#D55E00",
    "VEP-damaging\n(Over-predicted)" = "#0072B2"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "BRCA1 (Findlay et al., 2018)",
    subtitle = "Distribution of RSA | High RSA = Surface",
    y = "Relative Solvent Accessibility (RSA)",
    x = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 15, hjust = 1)
  )

p3
```

```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height=5.5}
loess_fit <- loess(function_score ~ ddG_pred, data = plotting_data, span = 0.7, family = "symmetric")

# Predict fitted values for ALL data points using the loess model trained on fil_gck_df
plotting_data$fitted_exp <- predict(loess_fit, newdata = plotting_data)

# Calculate residuals for ALL points
plotting_data$residuals_exp <- plotting_data$function_score - plotting_data$fitted_exp

# Compute Spearman correlation
spearman_r <- cor(plotting_data$residuals_pred, plotting_data$residuals_exp, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")
subtitle_text <- sprintf("Spearman correlation: %.3f", spearman_r)

# Plot
p5 <- ggplot(plotting_data, aes(x = residuals_pred, y = residuals_exp)) +
  geom_point(
    aes(
      shape = clinvar_group,
      color = clinvar_group,
      alpha = clinvar_group        # <-- map alpha to group
    ),
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(
    "Pathogenic" = 17,
    "Benign" = 16,
    "Other" = 16
  )) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Other" = "grey",
    "Benign" = "#1B9E77",
    "Pathogenic" = "#D95F02"
  )) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c(
    "Other" = 0.7,      # transparent grey
    "Benign" = 1,       # solid
    "Pathogenic" = 1    # solid
  ), guide = "none") +  # hide alpha legend
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", size = 1) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  labs(
    title = "BRCA1 (Findlay et al., 2018)",
    subtitle = subtitle_text,
    x = "Predicted ESM1v-ddGf residual",
    y = "Experimental SGE-ddGf residual",
    shape = "",
    color = ""
  ) +
```
